info.title: Harmonee API
info.description: Family organisation API: families, members and roles, calendar, shopping lists, meal plans and notes. Family-scoped endpoints return 404 to non-members and 403 to members whose role lacks the permission.

get.summary: Gets the signed-in user's profile and family memberships
get.description: Creates the user's profile on first call.

post.summary: Creates a family owned by the caller
Joins a family using its invite code

get.summary: Gets a family with its members, roles, and the caller's access

put.summary: Renames the family and sets the default role for people who join (owners only)

post.summary: Replaces the family's invite code; the old code stops working

put.summary: Changes a member's role or ownership
put.description: Requires ManageMembers. Granting or removing ownership, or changing an owner, requires being an owner.

delete.summary: Removes a member from the family, or leaves the family when removing yourself

put.summary: Renames a role and replaces its permissions

delete.summary: Deletes a role that has no members and isn't the default

get.summary: Lists all families, newest first, optionally filtered by name
Lists events overlapping a time range (default: the next 31 days, max 93 days)

put.description: Requires If-Match with the event's ETag.

delete.description: If-Match is optional; when supplied the delete only succeeds if the event is unchanged.

get.summary: Gets a shopping list with its items (unchecked first)

put.description: Requires If-Match with the list's ETag.

delete.description: Deletes the list and all of its items.

put.description: Requires If-Match with the item's ETag.

get.summary: Gets meal plan entries for an inclusive date range (default: 7 days from today, max 62 days)

put.description: Requires If-Match with the entry's ETag.

get.summary: Lists notes, most recently updated first

put.description: Requires If-Match with the note's ETag.

Bearer.description: Access token from Microsoft Entra External ID with the Harmonee.Access scope.
